title: Courtesy Bonus Award for Harbison Protection Contract Scope, Repair and Emergency Service Calls
content:
For the courtesy rate on a paid tune-up under Repair and Emergency Service Calls, a courtesy-program customer earns a courtesy bonus award for equipment protected under Harbison Protection Contracts. The record read is the customer's protection contract in active status and its equipment scope: a single unit, or a matched indoor and outdoor system.

**Rule.** A customer holding an active Harbison protection contract on a matched indoor and outdoor system earns a courtesy bonus award of 3 points. One holding an active single-unit protection contract earns 2 points. A customer with no active protection contract earns no award.

| Active protection contract | Courtesy bonus award |
|---|---|
| Matched indoor and outdoor system | 3 points |
| Single unit | 2 points |
| None active (pending, expired, transferred or cancelled) | None |
